I make my own bacon because it's all the water that's pumped into your smoked pig product that means you get all the spitting.

30 grammes of 1 part salt/1 part sugar for 1 kilo of belly of pork. Rub salt and sugar into pork (especially fatty parts), leave in a covered container, at a slight angle, in the fridge. Do this every day for at least seven days (or until all the liquid stops leeching out). Then soak in clean water for one hour. Change the water and leave for 2 hours this time. Then hang for two days in a warm, dry place.

Cooks up really, really crispy and all the fat that renders out can be saved and used for cooking later.

EDIT: Left out an important step - drain the liquid every day before rubbing in the cure mix (you don't want the meat to be sitting in any liquid during the curing process).
